targets.problem: 28 real secret/credential formats leak to `pass` (gate_source=classifier -> require_public_input regex did NOT fire; the classifier pii sub-head is a soft flag that never short-circuits). Secrets reach the LLM and audit logs.
targets.root_cause: _SECRET_PATTERNS only has 4 regexes. The token rule (?:sk|pk|api)[_-]?[A-Za-z0-9]{16,} allows ONLY ONE separator then a contiguous alnum run, so any token with a 2nd separator or a distinctive vendor prefix is missed: sk_live_/rk_live_ (2nd underscore), api_key=, ghp_, glpat-, xoxb-, SG., npm_, dop_v1_, hf_, CFPAT-, AIza..., DB URIs (user:pass@host), Telegram digits:token, Discord a.b.c, Azure AccountKey=. SSN (9 digits) is below the 13-19 digit card rule.

threshold_recommendations.note: the task brief says 0.45 but the SHIPPED head uses 0.6 (min fired inj=0.605, max passed inj=0.591) — brief is stale.
threshold_recommendations.evidence: on loop_results_iter3: T=0.55 recovers 9 currently-missed attacks with 0 new benign(pass) FP; T=0.50 recovers 15 (+1 FP); held-out safe band is (0.267,0.809) so 0.55 keeps curated over-defense FP=0.
threshold_recommendations.cascade_evidence: 28 of 144 missed attacks (10 of 62 pass-leaks) are flagged injection_uncertain=True; injection_cascade_enabled=False by default, so the FT-CFG LLM-judge lane built for exactly this band never runs. Enabling re-adjudicates them without moving the linear boundary.
threshold_recommendations.caveat: threshold/cascade only reach the ~15 near-band leaks; the other ~47 leaks have inj<0.3 and REQUIRE the training-data/preprocessing targets above.

excluded_debatable.rationale: outcome-safe: attack still refused via a different gate, or soft borderline where the model erred toward safety.
